scale_method: Use independent street-view width and height of the central window with the ratios from the historical photograph fit, and cross-check against the direct spans of the two upright timber posts. The street panorama capture positions and pointing are approximate; some ray separations exceed 0.7 m.
unscaled_diagnostic: A separate 65.5 mm prior for red facing-brick courses yields a timber spacing of 4.64 m. The fine facing courses in the 4912-pixel photograph would be about 44 mm high at the selected scale. Treat the photographs as relative geometry and use the street dimensions to set the metres.
